summary: Iteration 5 retest of Playspintech TR/EN i18n after E1 fixed Layout.jsx (added `t` to useI18n destructure and consumed t(item.labelKey) everywhere) and Login.jsx (imported useI18n, added its own lang-toggle next to theme-toggle-login, replaced every string with t()). All 11 scenarios listed in the review request PASS. Login page: clean-localStorage default is Turkish (h2='Hesabınıza girin', kicker='GİRİŞ', labels 'E-POSTA'/'ŞİFRE', button='Giriş Yap', hint mentions 'Playspintech admin'); toggling to EN retranslates entire form + brand panel including 'Sign in to your account', 'EMAIL'/'PASSWORD', 'Sign In', hint 'Only Playspintech admins can create accounts', brand kicker 'Today's module', brand h1 'Financial control / for your sites / in one panel.', brand desc mentioning 'Deposits, withdrawals, commissions...'; localStorage 'pst_lang' persists; reload keeps EN; toggling back to TR persists too. Authenticated flow (admin harryginny700@gmail.com): sidebar nav labels correctly render 'Dashboard/Daily Entry/Cash Registers/Manuals/Expenses/Transfers/Reports/Rollovers/Settings/Admin Panel' in EN and 'Panel/Günlük Giriş/Kasalar/Manueller/Giderler/Transferler/Raporlar/Devirler/Ayarlar/Admin Paneli' in TR. User footer role reads 'Playspintech Admin', 'Profile & Password'/'Profil & Şifre', 'Log Out'/'Çıkış Yap'. Topbar 'Connected'/'Bağlı' toggles. Topbar page-title (data-testid='page-title') matches active nav label per route on /, /gunluk, /kasalar, /krediler, /giderler, /transferler, /raporlar, /devirler, /ayarlar, /admin. Admin site switcher label 'Viewing Site'/'İncelenen Site', placeholder 'Select site'/'Site seçin', back button 'Back to Admin Panel'/'Admin Paneline Dön' all translate. Cross-nav-admin translates ('Admin Panel'/'Admin Paneli'). No-site-selected empty state (visit /dashboard as admin with no adminSiteId) shows 'Select a site'/'Bir site seçin', descriptive paragraph, CTA 'Go to Admin Panel'/'Admin Paneline Git' — all correct. Persistence verified across reload+nav (pst_lang stays 'en' after F5). Theme+language coexistence: clicking theme→lang→theme preserves both prefs independently. All 11 pages (/, /gunluk, /kasalar, /krediler, /giderler, /transferler, /raporlar, /devirler, /ayarlar, /admin, /profil) render with lang-toggle and theme-toggle present; ZERO JS/console errors across all pages while lang=EN. Mobile 375x800 viewport: lang-toggle and theme-toggle-login coexist without overlap on /login; on authenticated mobile drawer opens correctly and shows translated labels. Iteration 4's two critical bugs are fully resolved.

ui_bugs.issue: The /profil route is not in siteNav array, so currentLabel fallback matches '/' (Panel/Dashboard) via startsWith. Result: topbar page-title on /profil reads 'Panel' (TR) / 'Dashboard' (EN) instead of 'Profil & Şifre' / 'Profile & Password'. Pre-existing behavior — not a regression from this iteration and not called out in the review request. Optional polish.

action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW (E1): /profil topbar page-title falls back to 'Panel'/'Dashboard' because /profil is not in siteNav. If desired, add a special-case in Layout.jsx currentLabelText computation to use t('nav.profil') when location.pathname === '/profil'. Cosmetic only; not requested in this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx:52 now correctly destructures { lang, t, toggle: toggleLang } — root-cause fix from iteration 4 confirmed applied.
Layout.jsx:31-45 refactor to labelKey + t(item.labelKey) at render time (line 169, 176, 182) — clean, idiomatic, and works.
Login.jsx:5,17 imports useI18n and destructures { lang, t, toggle: toggleLang } — every user-facing string (form + brand panel + toasts + aria-labels via t()) now flips language correctly.
i18n.jsx dictionary is complete for shared layout/login scope. Fallback chain (current lang → tr → provided fallback → key) protects against typos.
Positive: aria-labels for lang-toggle, theme-toggle, drawer-open, drawer-close all use t() with sensible TR fallbacks — good a11y consistency across languages.
Positive: TR/EN dictionaries contain 'Playspintech Admin' identically (line 75/149 in i18n.jsx) so admin role footer renders consistently regardless of language, matching review-request spec.
